xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex045042026-02-2416-13-44" status="finalized">2 pa 'thad <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>phyogs</abbr> ngos bzung ba ni ¦ de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">chen po rnams</rs> la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba 3 byung ba las 'thad ldan gyi bzhed pa 'di ¦ log par shes par khyad <lb n="12a6"/> med kyang || zhes pa'i <abbr>tshig gi</abbr> don la yang zhud shing ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">sngon gyi lo chen blo ldan shes rab</rs> swo kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780"><abbr>chos mchog</abbr></rs> ltar bzhed pas <abbr>de ni</abbr> <abbr>rigs</abbr> pa <abbr>yin no</abbr> ¦ 'di ltar ¦ nor bu'i 'od la nor bur 'dzin <abbr>pa'i</abbr> blo de <abbr>mngon sum</abbr> tshad mar mi <abbr>rigs</abbr> te ¦ zhen yul la 'khrul <abbr>pa'i</abbr> rtog pa <abbr>la sogs</abbr> <abbr>spyir ro</abbr> ¦ <abbr>rjes dpag</abbr> tshad ma yang <abbr>ma yin no</abbr> ¦ <abbr>rtags</abbr> la mi rten pa'i <abbr>phyi ro</abbr> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593"><abbr>mkhas grub</abbr></rs> ste ¦ nor <lb n="12a7"/> bu'i 'od nyid rgya yin zhing de <abbr>rten no</abbr> zhe na ¦ de'i tshe nor bu'i 'od <abbr>rtags</abbr> ya <abbr>yin no</abbr> ¦ de'i tshe nor bu'i 'od la 'od du ma nges par nor bu <abbr>yin pas</abbr> bzung <abbr>ba'i ro</abbr> || </seg></TEI>
